MF_AlbedoRollOff.description: Hue-preserving soft ceiling: below Knee the colour is unchanged; above it the largest channel eases towards Limit (Knee + (Limit - Knee)(1 - exp(-(m - Knee)/(Limit - Knee)))) and the other channels follow in proportion.

MF_InkDerive.description: Paper-bomb ink colours derived from the buyer's colours. BlackDry = lerp(BlackInk, Paper, Mix) x Gain; RedDry = sRGBdecode(ValueScale x sRGBencode(RedInk)); RedPool = lerp(Y(RedInk), RedInk, Saturation) x lerp(mean(PoolGain), PoolGain, saturate(sat(RedInk) / RedPoolDefaultSaturation)), so a neutral red-ink pick pools neutral. The gains are fitted so every derived colour equals the art's palette at the default colours.

MF_LetteringBand.description: The kunai grip's lettering band (References/Kunai/LETTERING_HOWTO.md section 5). BandRect = (u min, v min, u max, v max) in UV0; Ink = LetteringMask(band UV).r inside the rectangle, 0 outside; BaseColor and Roughness blend to the lettering values by Ink. A blank mask changes nothing.

MF_NormalStrength.description: normalize(lerp((0, 0, 1), Normal, Strength)). Strength 1 = the map as shipped.

MF_TintDetail.description: Recolours a greyscale detail map. n = DetailBias + DetailScale x Detail is each texel's multiple of the part's AVERAGE colour. The colour is first lifted off pure black (max channel >= 0.01) and scaled down to LightestColour if it is lighter, keeping its hue. The detail exponent then shrinks with the colour's headroom, H = log(AlbedoCeiling / max(Colour)) / log(HighlightRatio): C_hi = min(DetailStrength, max(H, 0)) for n > 1, C_lo = lerp(DetailStrength, C_hi, DarkFollow) for n <= 1. Albedo = Colour x n^C x DetailMean / E(C) x K, E from the two cubic moment fits (the part's average stays Colour x DetailMean) and K = exp(-A(MipLevel) (1 - C_hi)^P) the fitted distance correction (the power law runs on the mip-filtered detail). At the shipped colour H >= 1, C = 1, K = 1 and the result is exactly Colour x n (the item's baked colour).
